name: Question 13
problem:

$$
{a}_{n+1}=8{a}_{n}-16{a}_{n-1},\,{a}_{1}=0,\,{a}_{2}=16,\,n\in N,\,n\ge 2
$$

use strong induction to prove the following statement:

$$
{a}_{n}={4}^{n}(n-1),\,∀n\in N
$$
